title: Kortix manifest
description: kortix.toml / kortix.yaml — combined schema covering every published `kortix_version`. Dispatches to the v1, v2 or v3 shape by `kortix_version`. Prefer this URL when the version is not known ahead of time; pin `https://kortix.com/schema/kortix.v3.schema.json` (or v1/v2) when it is.

config_dir.description: Directory with the OpenCode-only files (opencode.jsonc, plugins/, tools/). Defaults to harnesses/opencode, then the legacy .kortix/opencode.

connectors.description: An allowlist of names, or the "all" / "none" sentinel. "*" (alone or in the list) means "all".

kortix_permissions.description: Kortix permissions: the project.* IAM actions this agent may exercise, or "all" / "none".

env.description: An allowlist of names, or the "all" / "none" sentinel. "*" (alone or in the list) means "all".

apps.description: An allowlist of names, or the "all" / "none" sentinel. "*" (alone or in the list) means "all".

runtime.description: Selects nothing: every new session runs pi.

codemode.description: pi's codemode tool: the model writes a script that calls the other tools. on (default) keeps the other tools declared, only gives the model codemode alone, off removes it. An agent's value replaces the top-level one.

tools.description: Tools: tool name → repo-relative path of the module that implements it, or `kortix:<name>` for a Kortix tool. Each module default-exports { description, parameters (JSON Schema), execute(args, context) }. Every harness loads them. With a `tools` key, sessions get only the Kortix tools it lists; without one, they get all five.

anyOf.description: The Kortix web_search tool, maintained by Kortix.
The Kortix image_search tool, maintained by Kortix.
The Kortix scrape_webpage tool, maintained by Kortix.
The Kortix memory tool, maintained by Kortix.
The Kortix show tool, maintained by Kortix.

file.description: Repo-relative path of this agent's .md (frontmatter + prompt). Defaults to agents/<name>.md.

tools.description: Which tools this agent may use: harness tools (bash, read, edit, …), Kortix tools (web_search, memory, show, …) and project tools (top-level `tools`). `all` (default) or `none`; a list allows only those; `{ exclude: [...] }` allows every tool but those. A map of tool name → boolean is the earlier form.

network_egress.description: Non-enforcing declaration. Outbound network access remains unrestricted until provider gateway isolation ships.

pi.description: Pi native config directory (defaults to harnesses/pi, then .kortix/pi).

agentMdFrontmatter.description: Behavior for one agent — lives in its .md frontmatter (agents.<name>.file, default agents/<name>.md), never in the manifest. Provided here as an authoring aid; not itself part of kortix.yaml.

runtime.description: Selects nothing: every new session runs pi.

agent.description: The agent that owns the App. Grouping only.

skills.description: Skills: name → repository folder that holds SKILL.md, named after the skill. Kortix skills (kortix-*) are always registered.

tools.description: Tools: name → repository .ts/.js module. Kortix tools are always registered; a project tool with a Kortix tool name replaces it.

commands.description: Slash commands: name → { description, prompt | prompt_file }. $ARGUMENTS, $1, $2 … take the arguments.

extensions.description: Extensions: name → one implementation per harness. opencode: a repository plugin module. pi: an exact npm pin or a repository path.

ttl.description: How long a held connector call waits for a decision: `30m`, `4h`, `7d`. Clamped to 5m..30d. Default 24h.

spaces.description: Spaces: channels with a room (always the first tab) and configured tabs. Agents join one with `agents.<name>.space`.

header.description: What the space header shows, in order. Absent: every item.

tabs.description: The tabs after the room, in order. Absent: the default set.

embed.description: link: embed the page in a sandboxed frame.

blocks.description: board: the grid blocks, in order.

builtin_agents.description: Built-in agents the platform adds to this project. Absent = on.

my_kortix.description: My Kortix, the built-in agent you talk to. false removes it from this project.

permission.description: Tool policy. Omitted: allow. `skill` and `task` belong to `skills` and `subagents`.

prompt_file.description: Repository path of a Markdown file that holds the system prompt.

enabled.description: false: no session can start with this agent. Default true.

codemode.description: pi codemode tool: on (default), only, off.

tools.description: Tools this agent may use: harness, Kortix and registered tools. all (default), none, a list, or { exclude: [...] }.

skills.description: Registered and Kortix skills this agent may load. "all", "none" (default) or a list of names.

subagents.description: Declared subagents this agent may start. "all", "none" (default) or a list of names.

extensions.description: Registered extensions a session of this agent loads. "all", "none" (default) or a list of names.
